subject: math
title: Place value, comparing and rounding to 1,000

cards.front: What is the value of the 7 in 472?
cards.back:
70
7 is in the tens place, so it is worth 7 tens.
cards.say: What is the value of the seven in four hundred and seventy two? Seventy. Seven is in the tens place, so it is worth seven tens.

cards.front: What is the value of the 4 in 472?
cards.say: What is the value of the four in four hundred and seventy two? Four hundred. Four is in the hundreds place.

cards.front: What is the value of the 2 in 472?
cards.say: What is the value of the two in four hundred and seventy two? Two. Two is in the ones place.

cards.front: Which digit is in the hundreds place in 936?
cards.back:
9
The number has 9 hundreds, 3 tens and 6 ones.
cards.say: Which digit is in the hundreds place in nine hundred and thirty six? Nine. The number has nine hundreds, three tens and six ones.
Write six hundred plus fifty plus three as one number. Six hundred and fifty three

cards.back:
709
There are no tens, so 0 goes in the tens place.
cards.say: Write seven hundred plus nine as one number. Seven hundred and nine. There are no tens, so zero goes in the tens place.

cards.front: Write in digits: three hundred and five.
cards.back:
305
There are no tens, so the tens digit is 0.
cards.say: Write in digits: three hundred and five. Three hundred and five. There are no tens, so the tens digit is zero.

cards.back:
405
The tens digit goes up by one, and 9 tens + 1 ten makes 10 tens.
cards.say: What is ten more than three hundred and ninety five? Four hundred and five. The tens digit goes up by one, and nine tens plus one ten makes ten tens.
What is ten less than four hundred? Three hundred and ninety
What is one hundred more than eight hundred and seventy? Nine hundred and seventy
What is one hundred less than one thousand? Nine hundred
How many tens are in three hundred and forty? Thirty four. Three hundred and forty is thirty four groups of ten.

cards.back:
465
The hundreds match. 6 tens is more than 5 tens.
cards.say: Which is bigger: four hundred and fifty six or four hundred and sixty five? Four hundred and sixty five. The hundreds match. Six tens is more than five tens.

cards.front: Is 308 less than or greater than 380?
cards.back:
Less than: 308 < 380.
The tens digits are 0 and 8.
cards.say: Is three hundred and eight less than or greater than three hundred and eighty? Less than: three hundred and eight is less than three hundred and eighty. The tens digits are zero and eight.
Put in order, smallest first: five hundred and twenty one, two hundred and fifteen, five hundred and twelve. Two hundred and fifteen, five hundred and twelve, five hundred and twenty one
What is the smallest three-digit number? One hundred
What is the biggest three-digit number? Nine hundred and ninety nine
Round forty seven to the nearest ten. Fifty. Forty seven is closer to fifty than to forty.

cards.back:
40
2 ones is less than 5, so round down.
cards.say: Round forty two to the nearest ten. Forty. Two ones is less than five, so round down.

cards.back:
70
It is halfway, and halfway numbers round up.
cards.say: Round sixty five to the nearest ten. Seventy. It is halfway, and halfway numbers round up.

cards.back:
240
Look at the ones digit: 8 means round up.
cards.say: Round two hundred and thirty eight to the nearest ten. Two hundred and forty. Look at the ones digit: eight means round up.

cards.back:
200
Look at the tens digit: 3 means round down.
cards.say: Round two hundred and thirty eight to the nearest one hundred. Two hundred. Look at the tens digit: three means round down.
Round three hundred and fifty to the nearest one hundred. Four hundred. Fifty is halfway, so round up.

600
4 tens is less than 5 tens, so round down.
cards.say: Round six hundred and forty nine to the nearest one hundred. Six hundred. Four tens is less than five tens, so round down.

1,000
5 ones means round up, and 99 tens + 1 ten makes 100 tens.
cards.say: Round nine hundred and ninety five to the nearest ten. One thousand. Five ones means round up, and ninety nine tens plus one ten makes one hundred tens.
